0.original: Marcette would put you to work again, whether you like it or not.

1.original: The genius naturalist Marcette has deigned to appoint you to the most honorable position of Research Assistant Six, and promptly ordered you to procure a live lightning spark for her research. Weaken the creature and capture it in the receptacle she has provided for you.

2.original: You have captured a live lightning spark. Despite your concerns for the creature's fate, you have agreed to deliver it to Marcette.

3.original: Marcette is on the verge of another pioneering discovery. Despite your continued contributions to her research, she has yet to remember your number, let alone your name.

24.original: Use the thick glass jar on a weakened lightning spark.

25.original: Deliver the live lightning spark to Marcette.

48.original: Research Assistant Six. Yes, I am speaking to <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>, Research Assistant Six─that is the title I have deigned to bestow upon you after your humble contribution to my latest scientific breakthrough.

49.original: Mind you, now that you are officially my slave─er, <hex:021A020203>research assistant<hex:021A020103>─there will be no slacking off. I require a live lightning spark. Here is a jar. Now hurry─I haven't all day!

51.original: The mere fact that you dare to interrupt me means that you must have the live lightning spark I require. Well, hand it over, then!

52.original: Oooh, aren't you a cute little one!? Just think of all the fun I can have with you! The next assistant who dares shirk <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> duties is in for quite a shock! Muahahaha!!!

53.original: Now, where was I? Ah, yes, toadstools! If my theories are correct, sending a shock through the toadstools will trigger a sense of danger, causing them to reproduce with unheard-of speed!

54.original: Truly, my genius knows no bounds! To think of the discoveries I could make if I had but a single competent assistant! ...You! Assistant Seven! Or was it Four!? Oh, who<hex:021A020203>ever<hex:021A020103> you are, begone from my sight and let me concentrate for once!
